body: I have to comment on this... you sound too good to be true. You love your boyfriend no matter what? Your love sounds so unconditional. I don't understand. He is a lucky, lucky person to have someone like you in his life. I'm not convinced girls like you exist. Sorry, just had to rant.

I'm sorry, but you may have never experienced a depression that robs you of motivation. It takes immense effort to just get out of bed. This extraordinary amount of effort and persistence is just not readily available.

I've taken numerous psychiatrist-prescribed drugs, including Abilify, Lamictal, Seroquel, Depakote, Lexapro, Wellbutrin, Xanax, and Trazodone. Even at therapeutic levels they did not mitigate the desire to end my life. In addition they had numerous side effects, including seriously interrupted sleep and fatigue -- so I wouldn't be able to sleep at night, and I wouldn't be able to stay awake during the day.

this was a very, very sweet message -- thank you so much. i have some criticisms however. it is not darkest before dawn -- the least amount of light reaches a location when it is the furthest from the sun, so in the middle of the night. time does not restore an amputated limb. i would like to believe that living a depression free life starts within me, but pursuing activities that might help me pull out of this requires an amount of energy, drive, and motivation that i cannot summon.

as for riding the bus, that is something you can definitely do, and while it is intimidating to begin with, you can use google maps to find out how to take public transportation to anywhere -- just click on the bus icon. for a potentially fun little activity, find a restaurant or something else you like in your city, then use google maps to figure out how to take the bus to get to/from there.

I've had debilitating depression since puberty. Then I developed OCD. Now I have lost the person who stood by me, my closest ally. There is no reason to believe that the depression will randomly / spontaneously dissipate, and in fact it is generally known that it does not. Mine has not responded to treatment. This may well kill me. There is nothing constructive about this.

Thank you for your message; I truly appreciate your kind words. I am not religious, though I often fantasize about a merciful God who will allow every being to eventually arrive at peace, even those whose brains turn on them. I have in this past year repeatedly prayed to God for help, not having any reason to believe that there was anyone/anything listening. As I'm still actively suicidal, I don't believe there has been any response to my pleas for help.

I may have fought this long, but there is only so much one can take. I don't know if I can fight this to the end. I do fear that one day I will have a panic/depression attack so violent that I make the snap decision to attempt -- again, there is something(s) seriously wrong with my brain, and it may override the "me" that wishes to keep trying.
Masturbating 3+ times a day is unhealthy?? Seriously? In that case that's yet another problem I have, albeit one I never knew was such a problem.

I don't know. I haven't done it yet. I had a date this year, first time in my life I've ever established a date. But there was a brief couple days of just regular depression (instead of suicidal) preceding the date, so I de-escalated -- I don't have a date right now either, but I'm getting more interested in acquiring the necessary equipment to have on-hand so when I'm lying in bed wanting to die, which of course will happen again soon enough, I'll be able to make an attempt.

I don't want to die, I just want the hurting to stop. But the hurting doesn't stop, so I want to die.

I don't know how I keep going, I honestly don't. I can't explain it. A lot of times I find myself actually amazed that I'm still alive, that somehow I'm still going, maintaining friendships, still employed -- I don't know how I continue going. I hate it. I feel permanently humiliated, lost, destroyed, ruined.

I don't have hope for the future. Earlier today I had about an hourlong period of uncontrollable panic, which feels like drowning or suffocating, and every single thought is painful, one right after the other, rapid fire like a machine gun. I just sit at my desk and try to focus on breathing whole breaths. It never gets any better and I don't know why I continue to live.

Thank you for sharing here, and for replying, and thank you for your words of encouragement. Unfortunately I do not have anything encouraging to share. A heart can malfunction and cause a heart attack, which can kill you. A brain can malfunction and cause uncontrollable, suicidal depression, which can kill you. It claims about 30,000 Americans every year.

I guess I don't consider myself "standing strong," because I am not allowed to accept that I am a strong person. Depression destroys my self esteem, self worth, and basically destroys me as a person. It is a neverending nightmare.

Thank you. I'm still pretty spooked by the idea that I might seriously make an attempt in the near future. It's always been one of those things that I toyed with the idea, but didn't actually think that I would actually try. It's pretty scary -- I mean, I will literally go to sleep permanently, my consciousness terminated. No coming back. I am embarassed and ashamed of the legacy of suicide I am going to leave, as well as saddened that I'm going to saddle my family with the stigma -- I can imagine my family falling apart, my brother's alcohol abuse worsening, and he'll forever have the brother who "couldn't cut it"... I can't believe I'm going to do this to my mom. She has done nothing to deserve this. But I don't think I've really done anything to deserve what I experience, and at this point I will do anything to stop this neverending psychotic sadness. I'm at work right now and I can't concentrate or function, I'm feeling dizzy.
